Could be genuine current-production Artemide blue limited edition Nessino (retail new about AU$300 each) or cheaper copies; Gowans itself titles them 'mid-century modern style', and a near identical orange pair sold locally for $80.

viewing_check: Turn each lamp over: look for moulded 'Artemide' and 'Made in Italy' plus designer names (Mattioli) and a model/serial on the base or shade rim, and a CE or Italian label. Measure the diameter: genuine Nessino is about 34 cm, Nesso about 54 cm. Check plastic quality and mould seams, cords, plugs (Australian approval) and cracks. No marks means copies, worth roughly $80 to $100 the pair.
